xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex10012024-07-31-15-2466">'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6944">jo bo a pya</rs> na re seng bzang la lugs gnyis yod pa las | dang po ltar na las dang po pa'i sa nas sa dgu pa'i par du mkhyen pa gsuM bsgoMs nas | sa bcu pa la sbyor ba bzhi sgoM pa yin te | de ni rgyun <pb n="132a"/><lb n="132a1"/> ring por 'jug pas so || zlos pa'i skyon <choice><sic>sping</sic><corr>spang</corr></choice> 'di ni bshad pa sde dang bstun pa yin pas | rnaM pa <abbr>thams cad</abbr> du khyad par gyi laM zhes pa ni sa bcu pa la bya'o || de ni seng bzang gis rloMs nas bshad pa yin no || gnyis pa ltar na mkhyen pa gsuM thos bsaM gyis yul du byas te rnaM kun mngon rdzogs las dang po pa'i sa rang nas sgoM pa <abbr>la sogs</abbr> pa'i rim pa sngar bstan pa de nyid yin no zhes zer ro || </seg></TEI>
